summary: Ansible 12 removed the cisco.asa, cisco.ise, cloud.common, community.network, ibm.spectrum_virtualize and sensu.sensu_go collections, which can still be installed manually with ansible-galaxy.
questions: Which collections were removed from the Ansible 12 package?
How do I still use community.network with Ansible 12?

answer_card.title: Collections removed in Ansible 12
answer_card.answer_md:
Removed from the Ansible 12 package:

- cisco.asa (was 6.0.0)
- cisco.ise (2.9.5)
- cloud.common (4.0.0)
- community.network (5.1.0)
- ibm.spectrum_virtualize (2.0.0)
- sensu.sensu_go (1.14.0)

You can still install one manually:

```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install <name-of-collection>
```
